name: Splunk Observability Cloud Free Edition
free_limit: Splunk Observability Cloud Free Edition: Agent Observability for agentic applications and supporting infrastructure, up to 15 hosts, without a fixed trial period
watch_out: Free Edition concentrates on Agent Observability and up to 15 hosts, not every paid Observability Cloud module. Sign-up may require a request and platform eligibility; throttling and 30-day inactivity deactivation can apply. Commercial usage is restricted to internal business purposes; no service-bureau use.
